name: Yuuki Natsumi
source:
Natsumi is the twin sister of the deceased Haruka and the other osananajimi of Kanata. She is the tsundere piano player of the quartet, who is never honest with her feelings towards Kanata as expected of a tsundere.

[Taken from [url=http://amaenboda.wordpress.com/2011/12/07/shunki-gentei-poco-a-poco-review/]Aedes' review[/url].]
